parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation and no documented border, service, or police targeting of visitors weigh strongly. Positive signals include X passport/ID markers, identity-preserving hospital placement, a hate-crime law and a standing trans-murder conviction, plus a court restoring gender-affirming care after decrees. But these are mostly resident/health signals, not automatic visitor protections. The unresolved 2025 prison-housing decree, abolition of the anti-discrimination agency, rights-group deterioration findings, and lack of trans-specific social acceptance data leave recourse gaps. The aggregate hate-crime count cannot be read as trans-specific violence. Overall reduced-risk, below protective anchors because of the custody/open regulatory uncertainty.
